scope: Frozen bounded engineering tasks, not a human-preference or general benchmark claim

acceptance.tasks: All exact answers must complete naturally
acceptance.perplexity: Report both lanes and delta; no universal acceptance threshold

messages.content: What is 17 + 25? Reply with only the number.
Subtract 2 from that answer. Reply with only the number.

Choose from these fictional movies: Cedar, a calm comedy lasting 84 minutes; Harbor, a tense thriller lasting 91 minutes; Orbit, a calm comedy lasting 122 minutes. We want a calm comedy under 100 minutes. Reply with only the title.
Reply with exactly these three lowercase words, separated by single spaces, without punctuation: copper silver gold
The parcel label says blue: 16, green: 25, red: 31. What number belongs to green? Reply with only the number.
Count the even integers in this list: 3, 4, 7, 10, 12. Reply with only the count.

documents.text: A small garden needs sunlight, water, and healthy soil. The gardener checks the leaves each morning and waters the plants when the soil feels dry.
The library opens at nine in the morning. Visitors can borrow books, read newspapers, and ask the librarian for help finding information.
